_comment: Template character profile for scripts/rebuild_character.py. Copy this file to profiles/characters/<name>.json to author new hero, NPC, or boss avatars. Lengths are metres in character space (x across, y front-negative, z up, feet on z=0 after body_lift_m); pixels are from the source reference pictures.
name: TemplateHero
_asset_prefix: Prefixes every object, material and output file: assembly/<Prefix>_Character_Review.blend, export/<Prefix>_UE5.fbx, etc.

inputs._body_object: The acquired outfit mesh object inside body-acquisition.blend.

face_proportions._mouth_corner_lift_mm: Millimetres, straight up (+z) on [right, left] to match portrait smirks or asymmetry.

source_camera._comment: The orthographic reference frame measured by scripts/measure_source_frame.py.

_body_lift_m: Raises the acquired body so the sole vertices rest exactly on the floor (z=0).

body._hands_beyond_abs_x_m: Distance along x where the cuffs end and hand topology begins.

body_paint._side_band_abs_x_m: Width of side-view blend band; [0.0, 0.001] for 2-view (front/back) reference sets.
